question: What are all products in the electronics category?
sql: SELECT id, name, price, stock FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 50;

question: How many total customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers LIMIT 50;

question: Find all customers from New York.
sql: SELECT id, name, email, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'New York' LIMIT 50;

question: What is the total revenue across all completed orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

question: List the top 5 most expensive products.
sql: SELECT id, name, price, category FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show all orders placed in the last 30 days.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount, status, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Which customers have spent more than 500 dollars in total?
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING total_spent > 500 ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 50;

question: What are the names of customers who ordered Product 1?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.email FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = 1 LIMIT 50;

question: Count the number of orders per status.
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 50;

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

question: Which product generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_product_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_product_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show customers who have never placed an order.
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL LIMIT 50;

question: How many units of each product were sold?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 50;

question: What is the total quantity of items in order 101?
sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_items FROM order_items WHERE order_id = 101 GROUP BY order_id LIMIT 50;

question: List orders with total amount greater than 100 dollars sorted by date.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount, order_date FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 100 ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Find products with low stock (less than 10 units).
sql: SELECT id, name, category, stock FROM products WHERE stock < 10 ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 50;

question: What is the total number of orders placed by customer 5?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5 LIMIT 50;

question: Show the highest value order placed by each customer.
sql: WITH ranked_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, id AS order_id, total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rn FROM orders) SELECT customer_id, order_id, total_amount FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 50;
